newsitem.title: USA: America Online to lay off 300 staffers.
newsitem.headline: America Online to lay off 300 staffers.

text.p: America Online Inc. will lay off 300 of its 5,900 employees as part the restructuring that will divide the company into three divisions, the company said Wednesday.

"Although we were able to transfer many affected employees to new positions, there are some people for whom we were not able to find a suitable position in the new company," AOL Chairman Steve Case said in a letter to employees.
AOL said the cost of the layoffs will be included in a previously announced charge of $75 million in the current quarter, which ends Dec. 31.

A spokeswoman for the world's largest online service provider said the job cuts do not represent a downsizing move at the company, which has seen exploding growth in recent years. "The company will continue to grow," she said, adding that AOL just opened up a new customer service call centre in Albuquerque, N.M.
"We are going to add another 1,000 to 1,500 between now and June," the spokeswoman said.
She said that many of the new hires will be in the company's technology arena and in advertising sales, as it seeks to expand its revenues beyond subscriber fees.
